key_risks_to_thesis: Apple Intelligence / AI-driven upgrade cycle: If the on-device AI features embedded in the iPhone 17 series trigger a supercycle, revenue in non-holiday quarters could break materially above the $85–95B band, invalidating the stagnation argument and justifying the premium multiple.
